documents.whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
documents.whatsapp.subtitle: Link your phone number to send documents by message and validate in one tap.
documents.whatsapp.step1: Enter your number in international format (country code included) and link it to the current company.
documents.whatsapp.step2: Send a photo of an invoice or a receipt to the ARCOMPT WhatsApp number: the document is uploaded and the AI proposes an entry.
documents.whatsapp.step3: Reply “OK” to validate, or give the right account to correct; anything flagged by a check goes to the review queue.
documents.whatsapp.step4: Validating over WhatsApp requires a verified session under 24 hours old: click “Re-verify” after signing in when needed.
documents.whatsapp.security: The number is linked to your account and the current company only; the company never comes from the message.
documents.whatsapp.formHint: POST /v1/whatsapp/link then /verify, for the signed-in user.
documents.whatsapp.linked: Number {phone} linked to the current company and verified.
